name: io.github.frenchleg/saas-pricing
title: SaaS Pricing
description: Prices, plans and SOC 2/ISO/HIPAA/UK-EU data residency facts for 100 SaaS tools, in USD and GBP.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List the SaaS products this server has pricing for, with starting paid price. Categories: accounting, ai, analytics, automation, communication, crm, database, design, dev-tools, documents, ecommerce, finance, forms, hosting, hr, marketing, productivity, project-management, scheduling, security, storage, support, video-audio, website-builder.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Full current pricing for one SaaS product: every plan with monthly and annual prices, pricing unit (per user, flat, usage), limits, key features, free tier/trial, source URL and last-checked date.

product.description: Product name or id, e.g. 'Notion', 'slack', 'Google Workspace', 'M365'.

currency.description: Currency for prices. Defaults to the vendor's own currency. GBP uses official UK prices where published, otherwise converts at the live ECB rate.

tools.name: search_plans
tools.description: Search across all products for plans that include a feature (e.g. 'SSO', 'SCIM', 'audit log', 'HIPAA', 'API') and/or cost at most max_price per unit per month. Results sorted by price, cheapest first.

feature.description: Feature keyword. 'sso' matches any single sign-on incl. Google SSO; use 'saml' for enterprise SAML SSO only. Also: 'scim', 'audit log', 'hipaa', 'api'.

max_price.description: Maximum price per unit (user/seat or flat) per month, in the chosen currency.

currency.description: Currency for prices. Defaults to the vendor's own currency. GBP uses official UK prices where published, otherwise converts at the live ECB rate.

billing.description: Billing period. 'annual' gives the per-month equivalent when billed yearly. Default monthly.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare 2-8 SaaS products for a given team size: per-plan monthly and annual totals, applying per-seat pricing and seat minimums, plus the cheapest paid plan for each.

billing.description: Billing period. 'annual' gives the per-month equivalent when billed yearly. Default monthly.

currency.description: Currency for prices. Defaults to the vendor's own currency. GBP uses official UK prices where published, otherwise converts at the live ECB rate.

tools.name: get_compliance
tools.description: Vendor-stated security and compliance facts for one SaaS product: SOC 2 (Type II), ISO 27001, ISO 42001, UK Cyber Essentials, PCI DSS, GDPR, HIPAA/BAA, EU and UK data residency, whether it trains AI on customer data, plus links to its trust centre, sub-processor list and DPA. Each fact has an evidence URL.

tools.name: find_compliant_tools
tools.description: Find SaaS products that meet ALL the given compliance requirements (e.g. soc2_type2 + eu_data_residency + no_ai_training), optionally within a category and under a per-unit price, sorted by cheapest paid plan. Also lists near-misses where a requirement is unknown rather than failed. Requirements: soc2 (SOC 2 (any type)); soc2_type2 (SOC 2 Type II); iso27001 (ISO 27001); iso42001 (ISO 42001 (AI management)); cyber_essentials (Cyber Essentials (UK)); pci_dss (PCI DSS); gdpr (GDPR statement); hipaa (HIPAA / BAA available); eu_data_residency (EU data residency option); uk_data_residency (UK data residency option); no_ai_training (Does not train AI on customer data (at least on business plans)).

max_price.description: Max price per unit per month for the cheapest paid plan, in the chosen currency.

currency.description: Currency for prices. Defaults to the vendor's own currency. GBP uses official UK prices where published, otherwise converts at the live ECB rate.

billing.description: Billing period. 'annual' gives the per-month equivalent when billed yearly. Default monthly.

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: Dated log of SaaS price changes: price rises and cuts, plans added or removed, with old and new prices and % change. Filter by product, category or date. Use this to answer 'has X raised prices?', 'what changed in SaaS pricing this month?' or to warn that a quoted price changed recently. Fixes to this dataset's own errors are excluded unless include_corrections is true.

product.description: Product name or id. Omit for all products.

category.description: Filter by category: accounting, ai, analytics, automation, communication, crm, database, design, dev-tools, documents, ecommerce, finance, forms, hosting, hr, marketing, productivity, project-management, scheduling, security, storage, support, video-audio, website-builder.

since.description: Only changes on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

include_corrections.description: Also include corrections to this dataset's own mistakes. Default false.

tools.name: report_outdated
tools.description: Flag a price, plan, feature or compliance fact in this dataset that looks wrong or out of date, or request a product that isn't covered. Reports are reviewed by the maintainer.

product.description: Product name or id (can be a product not yet covered).

details.description: What is wrong, e.g. 'Pro is now $12/user/month billed monthly per vendor page'.
